title: Composition series of rational group-scheme modules
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $G$ be an affine $F$-group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme]. Let $V$ be an $F$-vector space with a counital coassociative coaction $c:V\to V\otimes_F F[G]$. Use rational subspaces and simple rational modules as in [def-sfb-rational-highest-weight-data]. A rational composition series of $(V,c)$ is a finite strictly increasing filtration $0=N_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq N_n=V$ by rational subspaces, with each actual quotient $N_{i+1}/N_i$ nonzero and simple. The restricted coactions on the $N_i$ are characterized by equivariance of inclusion into $V$; the quotient coactions are characterized by equivariance of the quotient projection. The filtration of length zero is permitted for $V=0$.

source.place: Sections 4a--4b, rational subrepresentations and quotients; finite composition filtrations as used in Jantzen, Representations of Algebraic Groups (2003), II.2 and II.6.
